triggers.name: independent_capture_closed_insert
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER independent_capture_closed_insert BEFORE INSERT ON independent_capture
                WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM independent_task_state WHERE taskId=NEW.taskId AND state='SEALED')
                BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'independent task is sealed'); END

triggers.name: independent_capture_closed_replacement
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER independent_capture_closed_replacement BEFORE INSERT ON independent_capture
                WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM independent_capture r INNER JOIN independent_task_state s ON s.taskId=r.taskId
                    WHERE (r.id=NEW.id OR (r.deviceId=NEW.deviceId AND r.deviceSequence=NEW.deviceSequence)) AND s.state='SEALED')
                BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'sealed independent original must be preserved'); END

triggers.name: independent_capture_other_pending
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER independent_capture_other_pending BEFORE INSERT ON independent_capture
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_capture WHERE state IN ('RECEIVED','WAITING_CONFIRM','CONFIRM_REQUESTED')
                OR (state IN ('INVALID','BUSINESS_REJECTED') AND failureAckAt IS NULL))
            OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM temporary_capture WHERE state IN ('RECEIVED','WAITING_CONFIRM','CONFIRM_REQUESTED')
                OR (state IN ('INVALID','BUSINESS_REJECTED') AND failureAckAt IS NULL))
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'formal or temporary input requires recovery first'); END
